a.lede: Rockstar has a history of releasing its games at lower framerates than rival titles. That's still the case with GTA 6.
a.title: Why GTA 6 doesn't have a 60 fps performance mode

b.lede: GTA VI will target 30FPS across PlayStation and Xbox consoles, with Rockstar using its own temporal anti-aliasing solution on the PS5 and Xbox Series X, Sony's PSSR 2 on the PS5 Pro, and AMD's FSR 4 on the Xbox Series S.
b.title: GTA VI runs at 1440p on PS5 and Xbox Series X, but just 720p with upscaling on Series S
